name: Rate, time, distance
definition: Distance is speed times time, and the same triangle rearranges to give speed or time. The usual difficulty is not the formula but keeping units consistent and handling two travellers whose journeys start at different moments.
recognizeWhen: how long does the journey take
two trains leave at the same time
he walks at four kilometres an hour
what was the average speed for the whole trip
misconceptions: I averaged the two speeds instead of dividing total distance by total time.
I mixed minutes and hours in the same calculation.
I forgot that the second traveller set off later.
